families.label: Retail Commerce
families.definition: Direct sale of merchandise and products to consumers or business buyers through stores, dealerships, digital channels, and specialized retail formats.

capabilities.label: General merchandise retail
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to merchandise, sell, fulfill, and service a broad assortment of consumer goods through physical or digital retail operations.

capabilities.label: Grocery retail
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to merchandise, sell, store, and fulfill food, beverage, household, and related grocery products through retail channels.

capabilities.label: Pharmacy retail
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to dispense prescription products and merchandise nonprescription health, wellness, and consumer goods through licensed retail pharmacy operations.

capabilities.label: Apparel retail
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to merchandise, sell, fulfill, and service apparel, footwear, accessories, or related fashion products through retail channels.

capabilities.label: Motor vehicle retail and dealership operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to sell, lease, finance, deliver, and service new or used motor vehicles through dealership or direct retail operations.

capabilities.label: Building supply and home improvement retail
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to merchandise, sell, fulfill, and support building materials, tools, fixtures, and home improvement products through retail channels.

capabilities.label: Specialty retail
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to merchandise, sell, fulfill, and service a focused category of consumer or business products through specialized retail operations.

capabilities.label: E-commerce retail
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to merchandise, sell, transact, fulfill, and service goods through a digital storefront where the organization acts as the retailer of record.

families.label: Hospitality and Leisure Operations
families.definition: Operation of restaurants, lodging properties, resorts, casinos, attractions, and other guest-facing leisure or recreation businesses.

capabilities.label: Restaurant operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate food and beverage establishments, including menu, kitchen, service, safety, staffing, and customer-experience systems.

capabilities.label: Hotel and resort operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to own, manage, or operate lodging and resort properties with integrated reservations, guest, housekeeping, facility, and service systems.

capabilities.label: Casino operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate regulated gaming venues and associated wagering, security, compliance, hospitality, and customer-service systems.

capabilities.label: Recreation and attraction operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate amusement, recreation, sports, cultural, or visitor attractions and their admission, safety, facility, and guest systems.

families.label: Bereavement and Memorial Services
families.definition: Care, planning, facility, disposition, interment, memorialization, and property services provided to individuals and families following a death.

capabilities.label: Funeral and cremation services
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to arrange and deliver funeral, cremation, preparation, ceremony, transport, and related care services for deceased persons and families.

capabilities.label: Cemetery and memorial property services
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to develop, operate, maintain, sell, and administer cemetery, interment, mausoleum, memorial, or related remembrance property and services.
